clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement. Note—This specification covers the requirements of ordinary Portland Cement for uses such as manufacture of prestressed concrete railway sleepers and precast products.

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: 3.1 Fineness — Specific surface not less than 225 m2/kg

clauses.title: Soundness
clauses.text: 3.2 Soundness — Unaerated cement not more the 10 mm by 'Le  Chatelier' method and not more than 0.8 percent by autoclave method. SUMMARY OF IS  8112 : 1989  43 GRADE ORDINARY PORTLAND CEMENT (First Revision)

clauses.title: Setting Time
clauses.text: 3.3 Setting Time — a)  Initial setting time in minutes —not less than 30. b) Final setting time in minutes — not more than 600.

clauses.title: Compressive strength
clauses.text: 3.4 Compressive strength — a)  72 1 hour not less than 23 MPa b)  168 2 hour not less than 33 MPa c)  672 4 hour not less than  43 MPa

clauses.title: Delivery
clauses.text: 4. Delivery — Packed in specified bags of  50 kg , 25 kg, 10 kg, 5 kg, 2 kg or 1 kg net or in bulk with tolerances specified in the standard.
